personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, readable modern-heritage aesthetic using deep royal blue and gold to honor family history without feeling cluttered.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm to reduce clutter. Tree nodes need strict padding so connector lines don't tangle.

do's: Use glassmorphism for the floating top header (tree title & actions) so the tree can pan underneath it smoothly.
Use glassmorphism on floating action buttons (FABs).
dont's: Do not use blur inside the SVG canvas itself.

screens.name: Family Tree Canvas
screens.purpose: An interactive, panning canvas to view and edit the family tree, accompanied by a clean glass header and a bottom sheet for filtering.

states.loading: Centered spinner in Royal Blue (#1E3A8A) with 'Memuat silsilah...'
states.empty: Illustration (Parchment/Tree) with 'Belum ada anggota keluarga' and a primary CTA 'Tambah Anggota Pertama'.
states.error: Message 'Gagal memuat silsilah' with a 'Coba Lagi' button.

screens.layout:
1. Floating Top Glass Header: Contains Tree Name (Playfair, 20pt) + Member Count Chip. Below it, icon buttons: Filter, Explorer, Ekspor PDF.
2. Canvas Area: Uses react-native-svg + pan/zoom. 
  - Nodes: Circular images (64x64). Focused node: 80x80 with a 3pt Gold (#D4AF37) ring.
  - Node Spacing: 64pt minimum horizontal gap, 100pt vertical gap between generations.
  - Connector Lines: Use elbow/orthogonal routing, NEVER straight diagonals. Solid #1E3A8A (Blood), Dashed #1E3A8A (Adopted), Solid #B91C1C (Divorced). Line width 2pt.
3. Interaction (Two-Tap): Tap once on a node sets it to 'selected'. When selected, render 4 mini circular 'Tambah' (Add) icon buttons positioned around the node (N/S/E/W). Also render a 'Jadikan Pusat Pohon' pill button directly under the node's name. Tap the node photo again to open the Member Detail modal.
4. Bottom Sheet (Filter): Title 'Filter Tampilan Pohon'. A gold chip showing 'Pusat saat ini: [Name]'. Two stepper rows: 'Generasi Leluhur (Ke atas)' and 'Generasi Keturunan (Ke bawah)'. 'Tampilkan Semua' outline button. Sticky CTA 'Terapkan Filter' at the bottom.

node_fallback_male.alt: Indonesian man portrait for dummy node

node_fallback_female.alt: Indonesian woman portrait for dummy node

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Surface is Cream (#FFFBF0), Primary is Royal Blue (#1E3A8A), Secondary is Gold (#D4AF37). Do NOT use generic grays or standard blue. Apply Playfair Display for headers and Poppins for UI body text.
For the SVG Canvas Connector Lines: Use elbow/orthogonal path routing to prevent clutter. Formula: M x1 y1 L x1 (y1+y2)/2 L x2 (y1+y2)/2 L x2 y2. Use corner rounding on the path if possible.
Node visual hierarchy: Normal nodes are 64x64. The 'center' focused node is 80x80 with a 3pt solid gold border. Names are max 2 lines, centered below the node, 12pt Poppins, color #0A1930.

Interaction logic: Maintain a 'selectedNodeId' state. If a node is selected, render an overlay on top of it showing 4 directional + icons (add parent, add child, add sibling, add spouse) and a 'Jadikan Pusat Pohon' text chip. This solves the discoverability of adding relatives and focusing the tree.

Implement the Filter panel using @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Use Indonesian wording exactly as specified: 'Filter Tampilan Pohon', 'Pusat saat ini: [Nama]', 'Generasi Leluhur (Ke atas)', 'Generasi Keturunan (Ke bawah)'. Provide '+' and '-' stepper controls for generation depth.

Place the Header floating over the canvas with a blur/glass background so users can pan underneath it. Include a compact Tree Title, total members count, and 3 distinct icon actions (Filter, Explorer, Export PDF).
